gloss: curriculum vitae; resume; career history document

definitions.gloss: curriculum vitae; resume; career history document
definitions.explanation: A formal document detailing one's career and educational history, used in job applications.

examples.japanese: {経歴書|けいれきしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
{転職|てんしょく}のために{経歴書|けいれきしょ}を{書|か}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I rewrote my resume for a job change.

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}と{職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}の{両方|りょうほう}を{用意|ようい}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to prepare both a personal history form and a career history document.

notes:
A document summarizing one's professional career and qualifications. In Japanese job applications, {職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ} (detailed work history) is typically submitted alongside the {履歴書|りれきしょ} (standardized personal data form). While {履歴書|りれきしょ} follows a fixed format, {経歴書|けいれきしょ} is more flexible and focuses on work experience and achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}: detailed work history (the full formal name)
- {経歴書|けいれきしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する: to prepare a resume
- {経歴書|けいれきしょ}を{送|おく}る: to send a resume

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}: personal history form — standardized form with photo, basic info, education, and work history
- {職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ}: detailed work experience document — the full formal term emphasizing job duties
